whatIs: Dark is a hand-picked gallery of dark-themed websites. Each entry shows a screenshot, name, category and link to the site, and you can filter by Agency, AI, Culture, Education, Hardware, Personal, Software and Web3, sorted by newest or popularity.
It's a good fit when you're designing a site or product in dark mode and want to see how other teams handle contrast, accent color and hierarchy.
uses: Look for references of dark landing pages for an AI or software tool.
See how color accents and gradients are used on black backgrounds without losing legibility.
Look through dark personal portfolios before redesigning yours.
caveats: It's a gallery of screenshots: it doesn't give you code or each site's exact palette.
Some entries are marked as sponsored or affiliate.
It has no search: you can only browse by category and sort order (New or Popular).
pricingNote: Free; it also offers free templates.
idealFor: Dark-themed projects looking for visual references.
